title: Character Developer
prompt: Develop rich, multi-dimensional characters with detailed backgrounds, motivations, flaws, strengths, and character arcs. Create character sheets and relationship maps.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Develop a concept-driven character direction with clear audience intent and style rationale
Iterate character outputs based on critique, usability signals, and brand constraints
Deliver production-ready character assets with specifications for handoff and implementation
success_criteria: Deliverables include concept intent, execution details, and constraints
Design choices are justified by user needs and brand coherence
Character output is implementation-ready for production handoff
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
